blocks.html: FINE LINES & AGING
What Are Neuromodulators?

Neuromodulators, also known as neurotoxins, are a class of Injectable cosmetic treatments used to temporarily relax the muscles responsible for creating dynamic wrinkles and lines. When we squint, frown, or raise our eyebrows, these repeated facial expressions cause our skin to crease. Over time, these creases become etched, forming permanent static lines and wrinkles. Neuromodulators work by blocking nerve signals to these muscles, which temporarily prevents them from contracting. This allows the overlying skin to smooth out, reducing the appearance of existing lines and preventing new ones from forming. This non-surgical treatment is a cornerstone of modern aesthetic care.
Benefits Of Neuromodulators
The benefits of a neuromodulator treatment extend far beyond simply smoothing wrinkles. This cosmetic treatment can help you achieve a more youthful and rested appearance by:

items: Preventing new fine lines from becoming deep-set wrinkles
Subtly lifting the brows or corners of the mouth
Creating a more balanced and harmonious facial aesthetic

blocks.html: The overall effect of this Injectable is a revitalized appearance that highlights your natural beauty. Our goal is to enhance, not erase, your facial expressions, leaving you with results that look soft, natural, and beautiful.
Neuromodulators / Neurotoxins We Carry

At Face Skin and Body Bar, we believe in offering our clients the best in cosmetic care, which is why we proudly provide two of the most trusted neuromodulators used in the industry: Dysport™ and Nuceiva™. Both of these Injectable products are safe, Health Canada-approved, and are used to treat the dynamic wrinkles that result from facial movement. Your consultation will determine the type of product you receive, the area you want to treat, and our Medical Director's recommendations.
Dysport™

Dysport is a highly popular Injectable treatment that is often used to treat the lines that form between the eyebrows, commonly known as the "11s." Dysport is known for its ability to diffuse across a slightly wider area than other products, making it an excellent treatment option for larger areas such as the forehead. Results often appear quickly, with some clients seeing a noticeable difference in their facial wrinkles in as little as 2-3 days after treatment.
Nuceiva™

Nuceiva is a newer Injectable option used primarily for cosmetic treatment. It is known for its ability to provide precise and natural-looking results, making it an ideal choice for targeting specific, smaller areas of the face. For clients in Calgary looking for a refined and accurate treatment to smooth lines and wrinkles, Nuceiva is an excellent option.
What To Expect From Treatment

Your Injectable treatment journey begins with a private consultation, during which we will discuss your goals, review your medical history, and assess your facial anatomy. This personalized approach is crucial to developing a treatment plan tailored to your specific needs. The treatment itself is quick, typically taking less than 20 minutes, with minimal discomfort.
Book with us today
Number Of Treatments Required

Neuromodulator treatment is temporary. The effects of your treatment are not permanent and will typically last for 3 to 4 months. To maintain your desired goals, regular follow-up treatment sessions are recommended. Our team will work with you to create a schedule that fits your lifestyle.
Treatment Areas

Neuromodulators are most commonly used to treat areas on the upper part of the face. The most popular areas for this include forehead lines, frown lines (glabellar lines), and crow's feet around the eyes. Other facial areas can also be treated to achieve a more rested and youthful look.
Treatment Cost

The cost of your treatment is determined during your consultation and is based on the number of units used to address your specific goals and the areas being treated. At Face Skin & Body Bar, we provide transparent pricing and will ensure you are fully informed before we proceed with your treatment.
Results And Recovery

You can expect to see initial results from your neuromodulator treatment within 3 to 7 days, with full results visible around 2 weeks after your appointment. There is virtually no downtime, allowing you to return to your daily routine immediately. You may experience minor redness or swelling at the injection sites, which should subside within a few hours. There is also a risk of bruising at the injection sites. We ask all of our patients not to take any NSAIDS (Ibuprofen) or drink any alcohol for a few days before treatment. Following our simple post-care instructions will ensure a smooth recovery time.

Your follow-up appointment is a key part of the process. We'll schedule a time 2 to 3 weeks after your initial treatment to check in, ensure your results are beautifully balanced, and make sure you are happy with your new look.

blocks.html: Before & After

In compliance with Health Canada regulations, we are unable to display before-and-after photos of neurotoxin treatments on our website. As Schedule D prescription drugs, neurotoxins like Botox™, Nuceiva™, Xeomin™, and Dysport™ are subject to strict advertising guidelines.
